setup_info.name: Configure a QQ Official Bot
setup_info.hint: Click Show QR Code above and scan it with mobile QQ to bind a bot and fill in AppID and AppSecret automatically. You can also create or manage a bot at https://q.qq.com and enter its credentials manually below.

zh.name: 配置 QQ 官方机器人
zh.hint: 点击上方“显示二维码”，使用手机 QQ 扫码绑定后会自动填写 AppID 与 AppSecret；也可以前往 QQ 机器人开放平台（https://q.qq.com）创建或管理机器人，并在下方手动填写凭据。
